Game Rules

Rocket Flight is a new generation of iGame games. You can double your profits in just a few seconds, Rocket Flight is built on a fair system of verifiable results, a true guarantee of credibility in the gaming industry today.

Rocket Flight is very simple to play:

1. Bet before the lucky rocket takes off.

2. As the lucky rocket takes off, the odds on the bet increase.

3. 3. Cash out: Press the cash out button to win X times your money before the rocket disappears!

More details

The multiplier starts at 1x and the longer the Lucky Rocket takes off, the higher the payout.

Your profit is calculated as the multiplier at the time you stop flying, multiplied by the amount of your bet.

The flight time of the Lucky Rocket is automatically generated by our i-Game supercomputer and cannot be manipulated by humans. It is fair and equitable.

Game Features

Betting and Cashing out

1. Select or fill in an amount and press the 'Bet' button to place your bet.

2. Press the plus icon in the top right corner of the first betting board and you can place two bets at the same time.

3. Press the 'Cash Out' button to cash out your bet. How much you win depends on the amount of your bet multiplied by the multiplier at the time of cashing out.

4. If you don't cash out before the rocket disappears, your bet loses.

Auto-Bet and Auto-Cash

1. Auto Bet: When this feature is activated, the system will automatically place a bet each time the rocket takes off.

2. Auto Stop Flight: When this feature is activated, you will automatically cash out when your bet reaches the multiplier you have filled in.

Betting results and Statistics

1. Under the game page, there is a live betting panel. Here you can see the bets placed by all players in the current round.

2. On the 'My Bets' page you can see all your bets and win/loss information.

3. On the 'Rankings' page, there are game result statistics. You can view your cashing history and the ranking of other players' cashing multipliers.

Other issues

1. If the internet connection is interrupted while betting, the game will be automatically cashed out at the current multiplier and the winning amount will be added to your balance.

2. In the event of a gaming hardware/software failure, the affected game bets and payouts will be invalidated and any affected bets will be refunded.
